body.statement: For the fixed common alphabet input \(\mathcal A\), use \(\mathrm{def:transducer\text{-}handle}\) to construct a bounded uniform fixing normal form and derive an explicit computable \(B_\star(n,L,\gamma)\) such that every reachable state either compiles one expression \(F\in\mathcal L_{\mathrm{cyl}}(\mathcal A)\) from cylinders in \(\Omega_{\mathcal A}\), valid for all compatible refinements, or extracts within radius and encoding size \(B_\star(n,L,\gamma)\) a finite lag-switch-hedge role pair on those same alphabets satisfying the premises of \(\mathrm{lem:stationary\text{-}lift}\), including states where every refinement is individually identifiable but the refinement-specific functionals disagree.
body.justification: This is the theorem-level open kernel: it must establish both bounded common-functional compilation and bounded positive stationary obstruction extraction.
body.gap: Fixed-ADMG ID, PAG regions, and periodic hedge cutting each preserve only one of fixed vertices, fixed lags, or a single graph; none gives a state invariant for lag-offset uncertainty and common-law functional disagreement.
body.consumer: The normal form makes a definitive identification or abstention decision possible from a latent-confounded summary graph without refinement enumeration or unrestricted elimination.

obligation.what_is_open: A finite offset-sensitive state space, a sound transition relation, a pumping invariant, an explicit bound \(B_\star(n,L,\gamma)\), and a rejecting-state construction of a fixed-alphabet positive lag-switch pair.
obligation.obstruction: The transducer handle is an instruction to adapt several calculi, not a mathematical construction: it specifies neither states as finite encoded objects nor rewrite rules, invariants, acceptance semantics, or a lag-hedge grammar. No frozen result localizes cross-refinement functional disagreement, and the general stationary lift used by the proposed failure branch is ill typed on fixed alphabets.
obligation.attempted: I tested the two obvious reductions. Raw quotient fixing conflates temporal offsets, and per-refinement ordinary ID accepts the proved lag-switch collision. Saturated-graph ID gives a sound acyclic subclass but not a fixed-alphabet negative lift or a cyclic pumping theorem.
obligation.partial_result: The finite lag-switch pair in \(\mathrm{prop:lag\text{-}switch\text{-}collision}\) proves that accepting whenever each refinement is individually identifiable is unsound.  The acyclic-summary helper proves a finite radius \(\gamma+(n-1)L\) and uniform soundness in the acyclic directed-summary subclass.  The corrected stationary lift converts only a one-role-per-coordinate finite collision with exact summary into fixed-alphabet stationary countermodels.  No bounded cross-refinement fixing normal form follows from these results.
